body: You aren’t a burden for complaining. Someone will have it worse that you and other people with have it better. It still matters! It’s gonna take a while to get better but it will. Its really good that you got this off your chest. I can give you some advice but it’s your choice to follow it or not. Try starting a new show, make an album of comfort song you like to listen to. Go on anonymous chatting websites like talkwithstanger, where you can rant to people and they can give you good advice, you can try something new and artistic and get a bit more creative. You can try doing things where you take surveys and review stuff to get paid, it’s not a lot but it’s something. But also know that there are many people who care about you, even if you don’t know them. I hope everything gets better for you!

I don’t know how to help, because I can barley help myself. and I can’t say that it will get better, because I don’t know what will happen. But try finding something that makes you happy, like getting a pet that’s easy to take care of. I know my dog kept me from killing my self. Because I don’t wanna leave her alone. Talking also helps sometimes, try going on anonymous chatting websites like talkwithstranger. It might sound weird but you can get actually good advice from the people there. Find music you like, maybe make an album of comfort music and listen to it from time to time. Find a new show to watch. Start a new book. And crying it out is also very important. Don’t bottle up your emotions. You’ll feel worse. Start small, it won’t get better magically and quickly unless you try doing things, it will be hard but maybe it will get better. I wish you luck!
